AdjustmentInput.description: An accepted fix: a change to how the drawing is read.

action.description: What the fix does to how the drawing is read, as the result's fix gave it.

entity_ids.description: Entities it applies to, for mark_bend_line and remove.

units.description: Units to read the drawing in, for set_units.

AngleInput.description: An angle together with the unit it is expressed in.

unit.description: Unit the value is expressed in.

value.description: Decimal value, as a string to preserve precision.

AreaLimitInput.description: A minimum area with an error tier and/or a warning tier.

error.description: Below this the part cannot be made.

warning.description: Below this the part can be made with reduced quality.

AreaQuantityInput.description: An area together with the unit it is expressed in.

unit.description: Unit the value is expressed in.

value.description: Decimal value, as a string to preserve precision.

BendAssignmentInput.description: Gives some bend lines of the design their angle, direction and inside radius. A bend line no assignment names is bent 90 degrees up at the brake's inside radius.

angle.description: Bend angle from flat (90 for a right angle, up to 180 for a flange folded back flat); 90 when omitted.

direction.description: Way the flange turns: up (toward the viewer of the drawing) or down; up when omitted.

entity_ids.description: Bend lines, as reported in the result's bends.

inside_radius.description: Inside radius the design is drawn for; the brake's inside radius when omitted.

BendLimitInput.description: A bending limit: an error and/or a warning threshold, optionally measured from the inside radius the tooling forms.

error.description: Below this the bend cannot be made.

offset.description: What both thresholds are added to: none (the default) or inside_radius, the inside radius the tooling forms (e.g. 2 x thickness + radius), so the limit grows with the bend.

warning.description: Below this the bend can be made with reduced quality.

inside_radius.description: Inside radius the tooling forms, as max(min, thickness_ratio x thickness) capped at max (air bending forms about the thickness with a die opening of 8 x thickness); the stock thickness when omitted. Bends are made at this radius whatever the design gives.

k_factor.description: Where the neutral axis lies, as a fraction of the thickness from the inside of the bend (above 0, at most 0.5), as a decimal string; it sets each bend's allowance. 0.44 when omitted.

limits.description: Limits of the bending checks; an omitted one is not checked.

max_angle.description: Largest bend angle the tooling forms, from flat (90 for a right angle); angles are not checked when omitted.

max_bend_length.description: Longest bend the brake forms (its usable bending length).

max_force.description: The brake's press force; each bend's air-bending force is checked against it when given.

min_angle.description: Smallest bend angle the brake holds repeatably, from flat (a shallow bend springs back unpredictably); not checked when omitted.

min_bend_length.description: Shortest bend the tooling holds (the narrowest punch and die segment); bends are not checked for it when omitted.

tooling.description: Punch and die the bends are formed with. When given, the engine searches for a bend order in which no bend runs the part into either tool; when omitted, bends that form a channel are flagged for review.

feature_distance.description: Least distance from a bend line to a hole or cut-out, which the bend would distort (often 2 x thickness plus the inside radius); not checked when omitted.

flange_length.description: Shortest flange beside a bend: the material from the bend line to the part's edge, on either side (often about 3 x thickness plus the inside radius); not checked when omitted.

min_inside_radius.description: Tightest inside radius a design may be drawn for, as a model or a request's bends give it (often about 0.25 x thickness); not checked when omitted. offset does not apply.

relief_depth.description: Shallowest bend relief: how far the gap reaches past the bend line (often the thickness plus the inside radius); not checked when omitted.

relief_width.description: Narrowest bend relief: the gap a bend line ends at, measured along the line (often the thickness, at least about 0.8 mm); not checked when omitted.

CapabilityInput.description: Describes what a manufacturing setup can produce, independent of any one job.

bending.description: Press-brake limits, required when process is bending.

hole_operations.description: Taps, countersinks and press-in fasteners the setup offers, which a check request can assign to holes.

laser_cutting.description: Laser-cutting limits, required when process is laser_cutting.

materials.description: Every material the setup can process.

process.description: Manufacturing process; the block of the same name is required.

CheckRequest.description: Asks whether a design can be manufactured with a capability and stock. The design file itself travels separately (e.g. as a multipart file); this carries everything else.

bends.description: Angle, direction and inside radius of the design's bend lines, for a bending check; a bend line not listed is bent 90 degrees up at the brake's inside radius.

capability.description: What the manufacturing setup can produce.

design.description: How to read the design file.

hole_operations.description: Operations (taps, countersinks, press-in fasteners) assigned to round holes of the design, from the capability's hole_operations. Each hole takes at most one.

ColorOperationInput.description: Maps one color to an operation.

operation.description: What shapes of the color are for.

angle.description: Included angle of the cone, e.g. 90 (metric) or 82 (imperial) degrees.

major_diameter.description: Diameter of the cone at the face.

max_depth_ratio.description: Deepest the cone may go, as a share of the thickness, as a decimal string (e.g. "0.6").

adjustments.description: Changes to how the drawing is read, accepted from the fix of a previous result's occurrences.

units.description: Overrides the drawing units declared in the file; required for files that declare none.

angle.description: Included angle of the V; matched to each bend (180 degrees less the bend angle) when omitted.

height.description: Depth of the die below its top face.

length.description: Length of the die along the bend, centered on it. Omitted for segmented tooling, assembled to each bend's length.

opening.description: Width of the V at the die's top face, as max(min, thickness_ratio x thickness) capped at max, since a shop picks the V for the stock (about 8 x thickness).

width.description: Width of the die's top face beside the opening, on each side.

ForceInput.description: A force together with the unit it is expressed in.

unit.description: Unit the value is expressed in.

value.description: Decimal value, as a string to preserve precision.

GooseneckInput.description: The throat of a gooseneck punch.

nose_height.description: Height of the straight nose above the tip, before the throat begins.

throat_depth.description: How far the body is set back from the tip's face, on the side away from the flange being formed.

throat_height.description: Height of the set-back part of the body, above the nose.

type.description: What the fastener is, e.g. nut, stud or standoff.

HoleAssignmentInput.description: Assigns one operation to some of the design's round holes. The holes are resized to the operation's hole_diameter and checked at that size.

operation.description: Code of an operation in the capability's hole_operations.

side.description: Face the countersink opens on or the fastener is pressed in from: top (toward the viewer of the drawing) or bottom. Required for countersinks and fasteners; ignored for taps.

HoleOperationInput.description: One operation offered on round holes.

bend_distance.description: Least distance from the hole's edge to a bend line, which would distort the thread, countersink or fastener; checked by the plan's step for this operation when the design has bend lines. Not checked when omitted.

code.description: Identifies the operation in a check request's hole_operations (lowercase letters, digits, '_', '.', '-').

countersink.description: The cone a countersink cuts; required for countersinks.

edge_distance.description: Least distance from the hole's center to any other cut (part edge, cut-out, other hole).

hole_diameter.description: Hole the operation needs (tap drill, countersink minor diameter, fastener mounting hole); assigned holes are resized to it.

materials.description: Sheet materials the operation is offered for, each with a thickness range.

spacing.description: Least distance between the centers of two holes with operations; the larger of the two operations' applies.

thread.description: The thread a tap cuts or a fastener carries; required for taps.

type.description: What the operation does to the hole; hardware is a press-in (self-clinching) fastener. It says which of thread, countersink and hardware apply.

HoleOperationMaterialInput.description: A sheet material an operation is offered for.

edge_distance.description: Overrides the operation's edge_distance for this material.

material_code.description: Code of a material listed in the capability.

max_thickness.description: Thickest stock it is offered for; omit for no limit.

min_thickness.description: Thinnest stock the operation is offered for.

HoleSelectorInput.description: Selects round holes by their entities or by drawn diameter (exactly one of the two), optionally within one part.

diameter.description: Every round hole drawn at this diameter, as reported in the result's holes.

entity_ids.description: Entities of the holes, as reported in the result's holes.

part.description: Only holes in this part number.

LaserCuttingInput.description: Holds the laser-cutting limits of a setup.

color_operations.description: What shapes of a color in an SVG drawing are for: cut, engrave or ignore (construction). A shape's color is its stroke, or its fill when it has no stroke. Colors not listed follow the defaults: stroked shapes are cut and filled_shapes decides the rest.

common_line.description: Whether parts may share a cut line (common-line cutting): rejected (the default; each part needs its own outline) or accepted (the shared line is cut once). Either way each shared line is reported as geometry_common_line.

contour_closure_tolerance.description: Gaps between path ends up to this size (at most 1 mm) are closed before checking and reported as warnings. Omit it to close none.

drawing_units.description: Units drawings may be in; omit to accept any. A drawing in other units is units_unsupported.

filled_shapes.description: What shapes filled but not stroked in an SVG drawing are for: engrave (area engraving; the default), cut (along their outline) or ignore.

kerf_width.description: Default width of material removed by the beam.

multiple_parts.description: How a drawing with more than one part is treated: rejected (one part per drawing), accepted (parts side by side are checked separately; the default), or accepted_in_cutouts (parts nested inside another part's cut-outs are too).

outside_page.description: What SVG shapes lying wholly outside the page (the viewBox) are for: cut (the default, as services that ignore the artboard do) or ignore (as when a drawing is printed to the laser). Either way they are reported as geometry_outside_page.

support_spacing.description: Distance between the bed's supports (slats or pins). A part shorter than this can drop between them or tip into the beam, and is warned about; not checked when omitted.

usable_area.description: Area the head can cut in one setup (not the nominal sheet or bed size). Parts may rotate 90°.

cutout_width.description: Minimum width of any passage within a cut-out or edge notch (slots and round holes use their own limits); not checked when omitted.

edge_distance.description: Minimum material between a cut-out and the edge around it; not checked when omitted.

feature_spacing.description: Minimum gap between two cut-outs, as a spacing rule; not checked when omitted.

feature_width.description: Minimum width of any strip of material within one outline, such as a finger, tab or tongue; not checked when omitted.

internal_corner_radius.description: Minimum radius of an inside corner of the material (a sharp corner is 0); not checked when omitted.

max_removed_area_percent.description: Warn when cut-outs remove at least this percentage of a part's area (a whole number as a decimal string, above 0 and at most 100); not checked when omitted.

min_tip_angle.description: Warn about corners that come to a sharper point than this angle, on the material or the cut-out side (greater than 0° and less than 180°); not checked when omitted.

part_area.description: Minimum area of the finished part: its outline less its cut-outs; not checked when omitted.

part_length.description: Minimum length of the part at right angles to its narrowest width; with part_width it sets a minimum part size; not checked when omitted.

part_width.description: Minimum width of the part in its narrowest direction; not checked when omitted.

removed_area_window.description: Also apply max_removed_area_percent in every square window this size across each part, to find a dense patch on a large part; needs max_removed_area_percent.

slender_cutout.description: Minimum cut-out width that rises with the cut-out's length, as tiers by increasing min_length (long narrow cut-outs warp the part); round holes are not checked; not checked when omitted.

slender_part.description: Minimum part width that rises with the part's length, as tiers by increasing min_length (long narrow strips warp); not checked when omitted.

slot_fit_clearance.description: Minimum clearance of a slot that receives the stock, as in tab-and-slot parts: its width less the stock thickness, for slots within 25% of the thickness wide (a slot as wide as the stock has no clearance); not checked when omitted.

web_width.description: Minimum material between two cut-outs in the same region; not checked when omitted.

LimitInput.description: A minimum dimension with an error tier and/or a warning tier.

error.description: Below this the feature cannot be made.

warning.description: Below this the feature can be made with reduced quality.

MaterialBendingInput.description: Says a material can be bent, and in what thicknesses. A material without it is not bent.

force_factor.description: Force to bend this material relative to mild steel, as a decimal string (about 1.5 for stainless, 0.55 for aluminum); 1 when omitted.

inside_radius.description: Overrides the brake's inside_radius for this material (e.g. a larger radius for alloys that crack).

k_factor.description: Overrides the brake's k_factor for this material.

limits.description: Overrides the brake's limits of the same name for this material.

max_angle.description: Overrides the brake's max_angle for this material.

max_thickness.description: Thickest stock bent in this material.

min_angle.description: Overrides the brake's min_angle for this material.

min_thickness.description: Thinnest stock bent in this material; no lower bound when omitted.

MaterialInput.description: One material a setup can process.

bending.description: Bending limits for this material, required when the process is bending.

code.description: Identifies the material in a job's stock (lowercase letters, digits, '_', '.', '-').

laser_cutting.description: Laser-cutting limits for this material, required when the process is laser_cutting.

max_thickness.description: Thickest stock the setup can cut in this material.

min_thickness.description: Thinnest stock the setup can cut in this material; not checked when omitted.

thickness_ranges.description: Limits, kerf and usable area that depend on the stock thickness, like a published table. Ranges are listed by increasing max_thickness; the first that the stock fits within overrides the material's kerf, usable area and limits.

thicknesses.description: The thicknesses stocked, increasing; a job's thickness must be one of them (within 0.001 mm). Any thickness in range is accepted when omitted.

usable_area.description: Overrides the default usable area for this material.

MaterialLaserCuttingLimitsInput.description: Overrides individual default limits; each replaces the default of the same name as a whole.

cutout_width.description: Minimum width of any passage within a cut-out or edge notch (slots and round holes use their own limits); not checked when omitted.

edge_distance.description: Minimum material between a cut-out and the edge around it; not checked when omitted.

feature_spacing.description: Minimum gap between two cut-outs, as a spacing rule; not checked when omitted.

feature_width.description: Minimum width of any strip of material within one outline, such as a finger, tab or tongue; not checked when omitted.

internal_corner_radius.description: Minimum radius of an inside corner of the material (a sharp corner is 0); not checked when omitted.

max_removed_area_percent.description: Warn when cut-outs remove at least this percentage of a part's area (a whole number as a decimal string, above 0 and at most 100); not checked when omitted.

min_tip_angle.description: Warn about corners that come to a sharper point than this angle, on the material or the cut-out side (greater than 0° and less than 180°); not checked when omitted.

part_area.description: Minimum area of the finished part: its outline less its cut-outs; not checked when omitted.

part_length.description: Minimum length of the part at right angles to its narrowest width; with part_width it sets a minimum part size; not checked when omitted.

part_width.description: Minimum width of the part in its narrowest direction; not checked when omitted.

removed_area_window.description: Also apply max_removed_area_percent in every square window this size across each part, to find a dense patch on a large part; needs max_removed_area_percent.

slender_cutout.description: Minimum cut-out width that rises with the cut-out's length, as tiers by increasing min_length (long narrow cut-outs warp the part); round holes are not checked; not checked when omitted.

slender_part.description: Minimum part width that rises with the part's length, as tiers by increasing min_length (long narrow strips warp); not checked when omitted.

slot_fit_clearance.description: Minimum clearance of a slot that receives the stock, as in tab-and-slot parts: its width less the stock thickness, for slots within 25% of the thickness wide (a slot as wide as the stock has no clearance); not checked when omitted.

web_width.description: Minimum material between two cut-outs in the same region; not checked when omitted.

gooseneck.description: A gooseneck punch's throat: the body set back behind the tip, which lets a return flange taller than the web beside it clear the punch. Omitted for a straight punch.

height.description: How far the punch reaches above its tip, up to the ram (a gooseneck punch is modeled as straight).

length.description: Length of the punch along the bend; the part may be slid to put the bend at its start, middle or end. Omitted for segmented tooling, assembled to each bend's length.

tip_angle.description: Included angle of the punch's tip.

QuantityInput.description: An amount together with the unit it is expressed in.

unit.description: Unit the value is expressed in.

value.description: Decimal value, as a string to preserve precision.

SlenderTierInput.description: A minimum width for parts at least min_length long.

min_length.description: Parts at least this long (and shorter than the next tier's) must meet width.

StockInput.description: The material and size of the job's raw material.

form.description: Shape the material comes in; sheet when omitted. Processes to come add forms, each with its own fields.

material_code.description: Code of a material listed in the capability.

thickness.description: Thickness of the sheet; required for sheet stock.

ThicknessRangeInput.description: Holds a material's kerf and limits for stock up to a thickness.

max_thickness.description: Thickest stock the range applies to (inclusive); thinner stock falls in the first range that fits.

usable_area.description: Overrides the usable area, e.g. a smaller area for thick plate.

ThresholdInput.description: Requires max(min, thickness_ratio × stock thickness, kerf_ratio × kerf width), capped at max when it is given. Omitted terms are 0; at least one of min, thickness_ratio and kerf_ratio is required.

kerf_ratio.description: Multiple of kerf width, as a decimal string.

max.description: Upper cap on the requirement, e.g. the smaller of twice the thickness and 3.175 mm; at least min.

thickness_ratio.description: Multiple of stock thickness, as a decimal string.

ToolingInput.description: A press brake's punch and die.
